messages:
rachael (Product): Thanks everyone who joined today's all-hands — quick thread to capture the open asks that came up and where we're dropping docs/owners. @here :wave:

samir (Eng PM): TL;DR on Dedicated GA timeline: target is end of Q2 (internal date TBC). We're doing a small canary next week to validate autoscale and billing.

mike (Infra): Can confirm canary pool will be 4x A100 equiv for 48h. I'll drop a runbook here tomorrow. Migration guide draft: https://redwood.internal/docs/dedicated-migration-draft (private).

nina (SRE): SLA question from infra teams — what uptime % are we committing on Dedicated vs Hosted? julia (CEO): We'll offer a 99.95% SLA for Reserved Dedicated customers at GA, with a 99.9% baseline for early access. Legal is finalizing wording, expect the SLA doc by Friday.

rachael (Product): Action items I captured from the Q&A: 1) finalize Dedicated SLA doc (owner: julia) — due Fri EOD. 2) Migration runbook and checklist (owner: mike) — publish draft by Tue. 3) Canary validation metrics + dashboard (owner: samir + nina) — share dashboard link before canary. 4) Customer comms template for GA announcement (owner: product comms) — draft by Wed.

samir (Eng PM): Canary validation metrics (initial list): 99th p95 token latency, sustained QPS per GPU, KV cache hit rate, cold-start latency, and error-rate by model. We'll use the new perf dashboard: https://redwood.internal/dash/perf/canary (will open to owners).

mike (Infra): Quick snippet of the canary test command we'll use (for visibility):
```
# run 48h canary against dedicated pool
./infra/canary-run --pool canary-4x --duration 48h --workload replay --models "redwood-7b,redwood-13b-quant"
```

rachael (Product): Note on customer asks about Private (VPC) onboarding: product will publish a checklist (networking, KMS, audit logs) and a sample terraform module — linking when ready.

julia (CEO): Heads up — partners team asked for a short FAQ for marketplace listing. Product + Partnerships to own that. Also appreciate that the GA SLA is higher than some asked for; we'll ensure support tiers line up.

devops-bot: Recording and slides uploaded: https://redwood.internal/ah/2026-03-22-recording and https://redwood.internal/ah/2026-03-22-slides.pdf

nina (SRE): I'll add alert runbooks for the canary metrics and a rollback playbook. tagging @mike for infra rollback steps.

rachael (Product): Owners — please drop a short comment here when your doc/link is live so I can summarize for leadership updates. If anyone has follow-ups that weren't asked, add them here or ping me directly. :thumbsup:

samir (Eng PM): Adding a note — need a small cross-discipline sync on the billing changes (metering + reservation semantics). I'll set a 30min meeting after canary results.

julia (CEO): Thanks team. Excited to get this out—appreciate the quick ownership.
